entities.summary: János Salamon Petényi, Johann Salomon von Petényi or Ján Šalamún Petian was a Hungarian priest who took an interest in zoology, travelling, collecting specimens, and contributing to ornithology, speleology, and paleontology. He is considered the father of Hungarian ornithology.
